        if nc -z -w 2 127.0.0.1 "$port" 2>/dev/null; then

            return 1

        if timeout 2 bash -c "</dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "✅ Service on port $port is UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ Service on port $port is DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

echo "Starting health checks..."

STATUS=0

check_port 3000 || STATUS=1
check_port 8080 || STATUS=1

echo "-------------------------"
if [ $STATUS -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Status: ALL SERVICES ARE RUNNING."
    exit 0

check_port() {
    local port=$1
    # Try using nc (netcat) first, fallback to bash /dev/tcp if nc is not available
    if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        if nc -z -w 2 127.0.0.1 "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "✅ Service on port $port is UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ Service on port $port is DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        if timeout 2 bash -c "</dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "✅ Service on port $port is UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ Service on port $port is DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

echo "Starting health checks..."

STATUS=0

check_port 3000 || STATUS=1
check_port 8080 || STATUS=1

echo "-------------------------"
if [ $STATUS -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Status: ALL SERVICES ARE RUNNING."
    exit 0
else
    echo "Status: ONE OR MORE SERVICES ARE DOWN."
    exit 1
fi
